text: いわを　あいてに　なげつけて　すばやさを　さげて　しまう　おもしろい　わざだ！

structure.jp: いわを　あいてに　なげつけて
structure.en: hurls rocks at the opponent and

structure.jp: すばやさを　さげて　しまう
おもしろい　わざだ！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, often something unwelcome for whoever it happens to. さげて　しまう = 'goes and lowers it'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: さげて　しまう　おもしろい　わざ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a thing describes that thing. すばやさを　さげて　しまう　おもしろい　わざ = 'an interesting move that lowers Speed'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. なげつけて = 'hurls them and'.
